subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's current-attempt replay metadata contract and server_error retry-before-failover semantics as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877 once conflicts and proof are resolved?
rationale: The implementation changes session/message retry behavior and an SDK-exported harness result shape, and there are multiple open candidate PRs for the same issue.

options.title: Keep This PR As Candidate
options.body: Require a rebase/conflict resolution plus full-runner or gateway proof, then continue review of this current-attempt metadata approach.

options.title: Choose Another Open Candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 or another reviewed candidate as the canonical fix if it has cleaner merge state and stronger proof.

options.title: Pause For Different Contract
options.body: Ask for a different same-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to add currentAttemptReplayMetadata to the attempt result shape.

recommendation.title: Keep This PR As Candidate
recommendation.body: Require a rebase/conflict resolution plus full-runner or gateway proof, then continue review of this current-attempt metadata approach.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to recent terminal retry/classifier ownership and likely able to decide the retry semantics and harness contract.
